text:
maya: Heads-up — starting an entropy-prioritization sweep to surface ambiguous prompts for hand-labeling before the quant bring-up. Need labeler bandwidth + golden updates.

samir: Nice. What's the sample size and metric? Is this on dev set or production logs?

maya: Will run on current prompt bank + sampled prod logs (~10M candidate pool). Metric = predictive entropy under the candidate quantized model vs float baseline. Rank by entropy delta (quant - float).

jordan: Can we dedupe with embeddings first? avoids us labeling the same prompt with tiny edits.

maya: Yes — pipeline intent: fingerprint dedupe (MinHash + cosine>0.92) -> soft window dedupe (edit distance) -> entropy rank. Keep a small fraction of near-duplicates for stability checks.

kevin: Important: exclude current golden set from this sweep to avoid leakage. Also stratify by length/mode: short (<40 tokens), multi-turn, code, multimodal.

priya: Labeling capacity check — we can do ~800 items/day with two annotators per item. For an initial round, we can take 2k items. ETA for annotation job?

maya: Target 2000 for round1 (double-annotation => ~4k label events). Aim to kick off tomorrow AM. 1-day turnaround would be ideal.

samir: QA plan: run small eval comparing float vs quant8 on the labeled set. Track hallucination rate, formatting regressions, and utility score. Fail criteria if delta > 2% absolute on any primary metric.

kevin: Add a token-level divergence trace to help root-cause quant errors. Example command:

```
python tools/trace_diff.py --seedbank round1 --models float,quant8 --out traces/round1
```

labeler-bot: New annotation job created: job_id=ann-20260321-17, items=2000, due=2026-03-23, owners=@labeling-team

priya: Acknowledged. We'll triage: 60% high-entropy, 20% stratified by buckets, 20% random baseline. Will post queue link when live.

jordan: For code-heavy prompts lower the cosine threshold to >0.90 to avoid merging distinct snippets. Also include dedupe fingerprint id in the label payload metadata.

maya: Good call. Golden refresh plan: after labels are in, pick ~300 highest-impact items (entropy * traffic weight) to add to golden after manual review. These will drive regression alerts.

samir: We'll wire the new golden items into the CI eval and set an alert: if regression on golden >1.5% we block rollout and open a triage.

kevin: Rollout ops: canary at 5% traffic, auto-fallback to float on error rate spike or quality alarm. Also capture perf counters (latency/p50/p95) for quant configs.

maya: Action items (owner):
- eng: run scoring job on candidate pool (samir)
- infra/algos: apply dedupe param tweak and output fingerprint ids (jordan)
- labeling: create job + monitor turnaround (priya)
- evals: set up golden ingest + CI test (maya + samir)
- ops: prepare canary + fallback policy (kevin)

priya: I'll post the labeler queue URL and expected timeline once job spins up.

maya: Thanks all :raised_hands:
